title_en: Doctors and Pharmacies (14/20): A Conversation in the Counselor's Office
note_en: The pattern 没有……而是…… means "didn't do X, but instead did Y": 咨询师没有急着给建议，而是先安静地听她把心里的烦恼都说出来 "The counselor didn't rush to give advice; instead, she first listened quietly." English often uses "instead" or "rather," while Chinese pairs the negative first clause with 而是 to bring in the correction; the same frame returns at the end in 情绪不是敌人，而是一个信号.
